hypotheses.title: Style Surface GARP Dual-Tenor Reversal with Cubic Conviction Scaling
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 278 Candidate 2, the dual-tenor GARP alpha cleared all 8 platform quality gates (Sharpe 1.92, Fitness 1.06, Turnover 18.51%, Self-correlation 0.4198). Applying a cubic polynomial transform power(group_rank(...) - 0.5, 3) naturally preserves zero-mean antisymmetry while aggressively flattening noisy middle percentiles and concentrating capital in the top 10% highest conviction compounders. This concentration expands the annualized return spread by 2x to 3x, directly targeting Fitness >= 1.50 - 1.80 without inflating turnover.
confounders: Cap-weighted concentration in a few extreme outlier names during market-wide earnings shocks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cubic scaling causes weight concentration failures or reduces Sharpe below 1.50.

candidates.expression: power(group_rank(group_zscore(ts_zscore(ts_backfill(fscore_growth * fscore_value, 60), 120), subindustry) - 0.30 * group_zscore((close - vwap) / vwap, subindustry) - 0.15 * group_zscore(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry), subindustry) - 0.5, 3)
candidates.rationale: Cubic polynomial conviction weighting applied to the Batch 278 champion alpha, subindustry neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Style Surface GARP Dual-Tenor Reversal with Quadratic Tail Amplification
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Amplifying overlay weights (-0.35 on intraday VWAP dislocation, -0.20 on 3-day return delta) and applying quadratic power scaling signed_power(group_rank(...) - 0.5, 2) selectively emphasizes stocks where multi-month fundamental excellence aligns with deep multi-horizon liquidity overselling. This accelerates trade execution profits and widens return spread to push Fitness >= 1.50.
confounders: Persistent single-direction trend regimes where 3-day return reversals fail to bounce
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if quadratic amplification increases turnover beyond 30% or drops Sharpe below 1.50.

candidates.expression: signed_power(group_rank(group_zscore(ts_zscore(ts_backfill(fscore_growth * fscore_value, 60), 120), subindustry) - 0.35 * group_zscore((close - vwap) / vwap, subindustry) - 0.20 * group_zscore(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry), subindustry) - 0.5, 2)
candidates.rationale: Quadratic signed power transform applied to elevated overlay weights on the GARP foundation.

hypotheses.title: Style Surface GARP with Volume-Weighted Intraday VWAP Dislocation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multiplying the intraday price-to-VWAP dislocation by relative trading volume (volume / adv20) conditions the mean-reversion signal on institutional order-flow intensity. When a high-conviction GARP stock deviates from VWAP on heavy abnormal volume, market-maker inventory imbalances are most acute, generating significantly stronger next-day mean-reversion returns that boost Fitness.
confounders: Unscheduled after-hours earnings releases or FDA decisions that justify high-volume price divergence
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume-weighted VWAP overlay fails to achieve Sharpe > 1.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.expression: group_rank(group_zscore(ts_zscore(ts_backfill(fscore_growth * fscore_value, 60), 120), subindustry) - 0.30 * group_zscore((close - vwap) / vwap * (volume / adv20), subindustry) - 0.15 * group_zscore(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: GARP foundation with volume-weighted intraday VWAP dislocation and 3-day return reversal, ranked within subindustry.
